fact: After the SIGRH biometric census of 158,317 public agents closed on 15 August 2025, the finance ministry reported 122,166 enrolled and 36,151 not presented (48.28 billion FCFA a year), with duplicates found among the enrolled whether or not their NINA could be verified.
title: Mali : le gouvernement suspend les salaires de 36 151 agents publics après un recensement biométrique
